description: Eerste Helmersstraat 231-239 (1899): 5 m red-brown brick fronts of four storeys under a cream moulded cornice at 13.5 m over a patterned brick frieze; three axes of two-light windows with a transom under segmental brick heads with a white keystone; the top storey's centre window round-arched; white sills; bellied iron balconettes on the centre axis of storeys 1-2; a brick wall dormer over the centre axis through the cornice with one light and a flat stone cap

wall-dormer.note: 233-239: a brick wall dormer over the centre axis, one light, flat cap

door-left.note: 237: house door on the left axis

door-right.note: 239: house door on the right axis

rhythm.identicalBays: upper storeys: 3 two-light windows; the top centre one round-arched
rhythm.symmetry: upper storeys symmetric; door left or right
rhythm.roofline: cream cornice at 13.5 m over a brick frieze; a brick wall dormer on the centre axis
